title: Aliens: Another Glorious Day in the Corps
subtitle: Cooperative Sci-Fi Survival Miniature Campaign
tagline: Lock and load, fire up the motion trackers, and survive the terrifying Xenomorph hive of LV-426.
loreSummary: Take command of Ripley and her squad of hardened Colonial Marines (Hicks, Hudson, Vasquez, and Gorman) investigating the silent terraforming colony of Hadley's Hope. Manage your Endurance Deck as ammo and stamina dwindle while Xenomorph swarms stalk the air ducts and steam vents.
keyFeatures: Faithful tabletop adaptation recreating the pulse-pounding tension of James Cameron's 1986 film Aliens
Endurance Deck mechanic: cards double as weapons, ammo, equipment, and group health
Motion tracker blip tokens that reveal lurking facehuggers, warriors, and alien ambushes
Progressive multi-stage campaign from the initial colony sweep to the climactic Alien Queen duel

aliens_hadleys_hope_campaign.name: Hadley's Hope Survival Campaign (Core Missions 1–4)
aliens_hadleys_hope_campaign.description: The complete cinematic campaign following the Marines through the colony, hive levels, and final evacuation.

aliens_airlock_incursion.name: Dropzone Reconnaissance (Missions 1–2)
aliens_airlock_incursion.description: An introductory 2-mission survival breach setting up perimeter sentry guns and reconnoitering the main complex.

aliens_ultimate_badasses.name: Ultimate Badasses Marathon (8 Missions & Queen's Lair)
aliens_ultimate_badasses.description: An unforgiving extended marathon incorporating rescue side missions, ventilation escapes, and the Queen duel.
